title: On a system of semilinear damped $σ$-evolution equations with different damping types in the critical case
summary: In this paper, we study the non-symmetric system of semilinear damped $σ$-evolution equations with different damping types, where two power exponents of nonlinearities belong to the critical curve, by using moduli of continuity in nonlinear terms. Our goal is to determine the sharp conditions on these moduli of continuity that guarantee the global (in time) existence of Sobolev solutions or, conversely, lead to finite-time blow-up.
